explication: Discourse is a self-hostable community platform. Members create discussion topics and interact through conversations, while the Rails API serves the Ember frontend; Markdown processing and Onebox turn authored text and links into rendered content. The README also highlights real-time chat, themes, and plugins, and identifies PostgreSQL and Redis as storage and cache/transient-data services. Sampled source supports the Markdown and Onebox internals; broader feature links reflect README descriptions and repository paths rather than inspected implementation details.
